about_the_game:
Plot introduction

This is a visual novel

At the beginning of the second semester of the second year of high school, Zhiyuan was sent to the political and educational department again for using the computer, and was forced to suspend his studies by the teacher, but he still did not give up and continued to influence the school through computer viruses and online activism.

Background of creation

Zhiyuan wanted to go home to attend high school, but who would have thought that after returning, the huge gap from Shanghai to Guangdong would make him face reality. He studied game production from 2022 to 2023. During the days of going to school in his hometown, he began to release games on Steam. He was disgusted with his first-year high school teacher xf, and used her to report his classmates. In addition, some classmates spread rumors about the dormitory incident of Guiyu Middle School, and the principal once told him privately, "I support you to draw comics, and you have to draw positive energy", which caused him to feel a huge gap again. He even handed a small note to the principal and teacher xf to show his attitude. However, it was the game he made that made him start to think about what Guiyu Middle School was against. Because the art is too bad, the plot is too scattered, and the theme is not clear, Guo Zhiyuan created a new game on January 18, 2025. The art adopts some two-dimensional and some realistic styles (no AI generation). And reorganized the plot to create a love simulation, psychological horror, and visual novel type game, which is still under development.

Author's self-narration

My junior high school life was really hopeless. I would be scolded for saying anything in the class group, so I had to study hard. However, in high school, everything changed. Not only did I make good friends in school, but no one was disgusted that I couldn't speak Chaoshan dialect (because I was born in Shanghai, but my household registration is a local), and no one bullied me anymore. In the second semester of high school, I spent time in the school library every day at noon, or played on the computer in the classroom. I thought that such a plain and happy life would continue. However, since I met pjp, everything has changed. The reason is that after gyk succeeded in love in the first year of high school, he also encouraged me to find it. I was very disgusted with this behavior, but the attitude was ambiguous at that time, so I accepted it without knowing why. I originally reported smoking and carrying mobile phones in school, but I didn't report dating, because I didn't want to care at all, and the school leaders didn't want to mention it. The only one who was willing to mention it was Teacher Xiao, "Dating is the most forbidden in Guiyu Middle School. You are also at the age of first love. If there is this bud, it should be nipped in the bud." After a series of events, I chose physics, chemistry and politics, hoping to forget the past, because she and I are no longer in the same class. PJP still respects me, which further confirms what myz said in the first year of high school, "She is a good person, but she doesn't like depression." And she was the first to discover that I have the so-called "emotional cognitive disorder." So throughout the first year of high school, except for the three notes I passed to her in the next semester, I never contacted her again. In the second year of high school, I decided to use her to plan a color revolution in school. The means were as follows. 1. Continue to write letters to seduce her to report me to the leaders for harassing her. 2. When the leaders deal with me, I will report all the names of my lovers. 3. The leaders expelled the students who were in love, and the color revolution was successful. However, I failed. The leaders did deal with me, but not because of love, but because I disrupted school discipline. I disclosed the love list to the leaders. The leaders said they would investigate, but in fact they did not take any action, and did not even ask about it. Thinking back to when I reported wyh for bringing a mobile phone, there was no evidence, but Teacher Xiao still called her parents. I began to doubt whether pjp interfered with the leaders' handling of the affairs of students in love, although she was unknown and very low-key in the school, and I had never seen any boys looking for her. However, when I went to her to settle accounts on October 31, she admitted that she received the note, but denied reporting it for her. In addition, yjq said that she knew who reported it, but could not tell me the name. So my doubts deepened... The various strange phenomena in Guiyu Middle School made me feel that it was better than any school I had been to before. When I was in junior high school, I always missed the elementary and junior high schools in Shanghai. I felt better when I came here to get high school. So, Guiyu Middle School banned smoking, books, mobile phones, and motorcycles, but it did not ban love! In order to find out the truth, I established the Guiyu Middle School Intelligence Bureau on December 10, 2024. There are currently four members, and there is an informant in Class 3 of Senior 2. Let me see what Guiyu Middle School is against.

Character Introduction

Guo Zhiyuan: In 2023, a student who was admitted to Guiyu Middle School on his own, worked as a spy in school, was often persecuted, and was accused of being anti-party, anti-social, and anti-national. He is currently in Class 2 (2) of Senior 2.

xiaofu: The head teacher of Class 1 (2) of Senior 1. After the second year of senior high school, she is now the head teacher of Class 2 (1), but she still teaches English to Class 2 (2).

myx: The head teacher of Class 2 of Senior 2.

pjp: In February 2024, Zhiyuan's "pre-love" spirit in the first semester of senior high school was already very bad, so...
